Container.Name: ShareDrive-AIO
Container.Overview: Standalone ShareDrive with web application, PostgreSQL 16, Redis, MinIO and ClamAV in one container. Your existing reverse proxy provides HTTPS and certificates. All persistent data and generated secrets are stored in /data; no Compose stack or external database is required. Allow at least 6 GB RAM and several minutes for first initialization. Bundled ClamAV signatures permit startup without a signature download; updates run in the background. Read the setup token locally from the appdata .setup/token file. Use a new appdata directory: this is not a migration from the separate-container deployment. Stop the container and back up all appdata before updates. Do not manually change database majors or overwrite generated secrets. Internal services run under their own unprivileged users; startup supervision runs as root without privileged mode.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: Forward your existing HTTPS reverse proxy to this HTTP port. Choose another host port if the existing ShareDrive stack already uses 8088.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Entire persistent AIO installation, including database, objects, signatures and private secrets. Use a new directory, not existing Compose appdata. Back up while stopped.

Config.Name: Trusted reverse proxy
Config.Description: Actual connecting proxy IP or CIDR as seen by the app, comma-separated. loopback does not automatically trust your LAN or Docker network. Avoid trusting all clients.

Config.Name: SMTP host allowlist
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated list of exact SMTP hostnames. Leave empty when no hostname allowlist is needed.

Config.Name: Public application URL
Config.Description: Optional HTTP(S) origin without path, credentials, query or fragment, e.g. https://share.example.com. App default: http://localhost. Empty preserves the web-admin setting; nonempty is managed here.

Config.Name: Maximum file size (MiB)
Config.Description: Optional integer 1-81920 MiB (1 MiB = 1048576 bytes). App default: 5120 MiB. Must not exceed transfer limit. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: Maximum transfer size (MiB)
Config.Description: Optional integer 1-81920 MiB. App default: 10240 MiB. Must be at least the file limit. Set your reverse proxy upload limit accordingly. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: Application name
Config.Description: Optional 1-100 characters. App default: ShareDrive. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: Application description
Config.Description: Optional description, maximum 500 characters. App default: Fast, secure & beautiful file sharing. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: Maximum files per transfer
Config.Description: Optional integer 1-1000 files. App default: 100. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: User storage quota (MiB)
Config.Description: Optional integer MiB. 0 means unlimited, app default: 0. Empty preserves web-admin setting; applies to registered users.

Config.Name: Anonymous transfer retention (days)
Config.Description: Optional integer 1-365 days. App default: 7 days. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: Registered transfer retention (days)
Config.Description: Optional integer 1-365 days. App default: 30 days. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: SMTP enabled
Config.Description: Empty preserves web-admin setting; true enables outgoing email, false disables it. App default: false. Configure host, sender and authentication as required.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Optional hostname without protocol or path, maximum 253 characters. App default: empty. Empty preserves web-admin setting. Must match SMTP host allowlist if set.

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: Optional integer 1-65535. App default: 587. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: SMTP implicit TLS
Config.Description: Empty preserves web-admin setting. true uses implicit TLS (usually port 465); false permits STARTTLS (usually 587). App default: false.

Config.Name: SMTP username
Config.Description: Optional SMTP authentication username, maximum 254 characters. App default: empty. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: Optional SMTP authentication password, maximum 1024 characters. App default: empty. Empty preserves web-admin setting. Masked only in the GUI: Docker environment and saved user-template XML contain the value; protect flash backups.

Config.Name: SMTP sender address
Config.Description: Optional valid sender email address. App default: noreply@sharedrive.local. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: Registration enabled
Config.Description: Empty preserves web-admin setting; true permits registration, false disables it. App default: true.

Config.Name: Require email verification
Config.Description: Empty preserves web-admin setting. true requires verified email and enabled SMTP. App default: false.

Config.Name: Virus scanning enabled
Config.Description: Empty preserves web-admin setting. App default: true. false disables upload scanning and reduces protection; bundled ClamAV still runs.

Config.Name: Primary color
Config.Description: Optional six-digit hex color including #. App default: #6366f1. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: Application logo URL
Config.Description: Optional HTTPS image URL or existing /api/assets/ path, maximum 2048 characters. App default: empty. Changes the web application logo, not DockerMan's icon. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: Application favicon URL
Config.Description: Optional HTTPS favicon URL or existing /api/assets/ path, maximum 2048 characters. App default: empty. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: Audit log retention (days)
Config.Description: Optional integer 1-365 days. App default: 30 days. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: Privacy policy
Config.Description: Optional privacy policy text, maximum 100000 characters. App default: empty. Empty preserves web-admin setting. For long multiline text, the web-admin editor is more convenient.

Config.Name: Imprint
Config.Description: Optional imprint text, maximum 100000 characters. App default: empty. Empty preserves web-admin setting. For long multiline text, the web-admin editor is more convenient.

Config.Name: External S3 enabled
Config.Description: Empty preserves web-admin setting; true uses the external S3 settings below instead of bundled MinIO. App default: false. This does not migrate existing files; verify existing transfers before switching storage.

Config.Name: External S3 endpoint
Config.Description: Optional S3 hostname without protocol or path. App default: empty. Required for external S3. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: External S3 port
Config.Description: Optional integer 1-65535. App default: 443. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: External S3 TLS
Config.Description: Empty preserves web-admin setting. true uses HTTPS, false uses HTTP. App default: true.

Config.Name: External S3 region
Config.Description: Optional provider region, e.g. us-east-1. App default: empty (provider default). Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: External S3 bucket
Config.Description: Optional existing S3 bucket name. App default: empty. Required for external S3. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: External S3 access key
Config.Description: Optional provider access key. App default: empty. Required for external S3. Empty preserves web-admin setting.

Config.Name: External S3 secret key
Config.Description: Optional provider secret key. App default: empty. Required for external S3. Empty preserves web-admin setting. Masked only in the GUI: Docker environment and saved user-template XML contain the value; protect flash backups.
